sources.title: GitHub - h-abid97/sft-gpt-oss: End-to-end LoRA fine-tuning of GPT-OSS ...
sources.snippet: This repository demonstrates an end-to-end workflow for fine-tuning the GPT‑OSS 20B model using LoRA adapters and Hugging Face TRL for efficient supervised fine‑tuning (SFT). The pipeline is designed to reduce GPU memory usage with 4‑bit quantization while enabling high‑quality instruction following and multilingual reasoning.
